_about: Copy to config.json and edit. Any key starting with _ is ignored, so use them for comments. config.json is git-ignored.
_secrets: No credentials live in this file. source.auth_env_var NAMES an environment variable; the value is read at request time and never logged or written to a run report.

source._base_url: Any REST endpoint returning a JSON array under records_path, paged by offset/limit. The default points at the bundled demo API.
source._max_pages: 0 means no limit; set it to smoke-test against a large source.

retry._max_attempts: Counts the first attempt: 4 means 1 try plus 3 retries.
retry._jitter: Randomises each delay by +/- this fraction.

_mapping: Dotted paths from a source record to the canonical contact fields. Use full_name, or first_name plus last_name.

mapping._updated_at: Optional. When present it picks the winner among duplicates; when absent, first seen wins.
